name: P. L. Westoby’s Manuscripts & Printed Literature
note: The Bookhounds’ shop, at 106 New Bond Street.

name: John’s Walk
note: An alley that ends at a stone door.

name: The Broadgate Hotel
note: Fletcher was to meet Drummel here.

name: The Ten Bells
note: Drummel confronted Bacon here, Bacon held his auction here, and the Caedis Urbi Verae Claves was burned in its fireplace.

name: Whitechapel
note: White eyes appeared on the walls, one-eyed tramps walked the streets, and Westoby’s map was pinned here.

name: Bacon’s lodgings, Southwark
note: The Bookhounds found a dead painter and the canvas here.

name: Westoby’s rowhouse
note: Bob found the portrait, the laboratory and the sealed room here.

name: The Red Lion
note: A pub a few streets from the shop, where Charlie made his truce with Drummel.

name: Westminster
note: The Shadow on the Throne begins here.
